turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I've spent a week trying to download my statement and this is frustrating.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.text: Go to Documents and click Download.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.text: I'm glad you have it. Can I help with anything else? Goodbye.

criteria.label: Эмпатия и клиентоориентированность
criteria.instruction: Yes for politeness and, when the client expresses dissatisfaction or inconvenience, acknowledgment of the specific problem.

criteria.label: Завершение
criteria.instruction: Yes if the operator summarizes or offers further help and says goodbye.
criteria.na_rule: The dialogue ended before the operator could close it.
